scope: Pre-output review of initial GLiNER native worker/observer after acquisition but before tokenizer preparation, entity model construction or detector forward.
decision: Two concrete blockers require narrow implementation correction; original plan, sources, labels, threshold and criteria remain fixed.

findings.confirmed: Actual harmless subprocess control returned monitor passed=true/owned_processes_stopped=true while a live child remained in the worker process group. The probe killed its child and verified cleanup.
findings.required_fix: Discover and account for live owned group/session plus retained identities after leader exit; signal and reap owned children regardless of leader status; verify no live survivors before passing.

findings.confirmed: Exact pinned pure native collation code returns dict {1: person} for entity_types=[person], while worker guard requires a list containing that dict.
findings.required_fix: Bind the guard to the exact native shared dictionary without relaxing label or mapping content.

additional_evidence_order_note: Persist actual tensor/token/class observations before rejecting a mismatch, retaining the failed native input for audit.
